description: Source code for managing plugin commands within the Mattermost server, including registration, unregistration, command execution, and plugin health checks.

classes.name: PluginCommand
classes.description: Represents a plugin command with associated command data and plugin ID.

methods.name: RegisterPluginCommand
methods.description: Registers a new plugin command, updating existing ones if trigger and team ID match.

methods.name: UnregisterPluginCommand
methods.description: Unregisters a specific plugin command based on plugin ID, team ID, and trigger.

methods.name: unregisterPluginCommands
methods.description: Unregisters all plugin commands associated with a specific plugin ID.

methods.name: CommandsForTeam
methods.description: Returns all plugin commands available for a specific team.

methods.name: tryExecutePluginCommand
methods.description: Attempts to execute a plugin command based on provided arguments, handling plugin health and errors.
